name: Call of Water
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.

narrative.details:
Long has it been since ye were last tested, adventurer. Ye have shown patience thus far in yer studies, but the time has come for ye to learn about the purity of water.

Seek out Norric Lochthane in Loch Modan. He is along the north western edge o' the lake, south of Stonewrought Dam. Ye  will find him there at his burrow hut. Good luck to ye, adventurer.
narrative.objectives: Find Norric Lochthane in Loch Modan.
narrative.offerRewardText: The wind's rushin' at yer back, the stone's firm beneath yer boots, and the fire in yer belly's burnin' bright. Aye, it's time ye learned the truth o' water's purity. Yer path's been long, but it's yer spirit that'll carry ye further still. Now, go on, take that first step. The mountain waits for no one.
